claims: John Ratcliffe is the Director of the Central Intelligence Agency (D/CIA).
John Ratcliffe was sworn in on January 23, 2025.
John Ratcliffe reports to the Director of National Intelligence (DNI).
John Ratcliffe manages intelligence collection, analysis, and operations.
John Ratcliffe is an attorney and politician.
John Ratcliffe previously served as the 6th Director of National Intelligence (2020–2021).
John Ratcliffe is the first person to serve as both Director of National Intelligence and Director of the CIA.
John Ratcliffe served as a U.S. Representative for Texas's 4th congressional district (2015–2020).
John Ratcliffe served as U.S. Attorney for the Eastern District of Texas.
John Ratcliffe manages the CIA's efforts in intelligence collection, covert action, and counterintelligence.
The Deputy Director (DD/CIA) supports the Director in managing daily agency operations.
William Burns was Director of the CIA from 2021 to 2025.
Gina Haspel was Director of the CIA from 2018 to 2021.
John Ratcliffe was preceded by William Burns as Director of the CIA.
The Director of the CIA is nominated by the President.
The Director of the CIA is confirmed by the U.S. Senate.
